part: cards: 640x400 RGBA, 10x10 grid, 64x40, quarter-pixel layer stagger, insertion order
note: Grad/Shadow records; card i in cell i%100, last card is the foreground

part: body: translucent rounded 60x36 with deterministic palette and asymmetric two-stop gradient
note: Grad, stop alphas 0xd4/0xb8, direction (700000,-300000) in the seam's units

part: two outer shadows, distinct spread/offset/blur
note: Shadow (spline blur: blur is two sigma) with spread via Grow; spreads +2/-1 px, offsets (0,3)/(2,5), blur 6/3 px

part: shared procedural PNG tile every 16 cards
note: no image/texture paint in the seam; no tile is drawn

part: foreground card as motion subject
note: last card

part: scroll strip with mounted rows limited by the framework API
note: ten-column strip panned by uniform words; all cards stay mounted (no virtualisation API in the seam), so footprint does not follow exposure

part: stroked cubic and even-odd filled path
note: no path primitive

part: rounded clips and alpha mask
note: Clip is a rectangle (one rect-clipped rounded fill is drawn); rounded-rect clip and alpha mask MISSING

part: filtered group: blur 3, saturate 1.4, brightness 0.8, drop-shadow sigma 4 offset (3,5)
note: no subtree group; the legacy `video` cell puts brightness 0.8 / saturation 1.4 on each pane's backdrop as a stand-in; `glass` panes have no filter

part: three fills: hash-noise plasma, circle-minus-circle SDF, moving sine-ramp uniform
note: three Shader records using the two built-in nodes (stripes, ripple), clock word moving; plasma, SDF and sine-ramp MISSING (author shader registration not built)

part: four 112x76 frosted panels, radius 12, backdrop sigma 6 px
note: Backdrop + Border; sigma 6; tint is the translucent border fill

part: 256x144 video, 120 frames 30 fps, 4:2:0 limited BT.709, new frame per four ticks
note: Synth pattern (bars + box), NV12 BT.709; new frame each 4 ticks in glass/video; not a 120-frame loop and no codec (decode is the generator)

part: fixed virtual timestamps
note: tick k at k*1000/120 ms (U_TIME)

part: cell startup (fresh process)
note: `measure startup N` times mount + first frame in-process; fx-seam-run.sh also spawns fresh processes

part: cell idle
note: frozen shader clock; zero recs/tiles/layer work and no active records asserted

part: cell one (interrupt at 100 ms by 10 px)
note: spring to +10 px at tick 1, retargeted to -10 px at tick 12

part: cell many (stagger translation/opacity/colour/width, interrupt at 100 ms, spring k=260 c=23 on every other card)
note: Prog on rect, colour and opacity; every record rewritten at tick 12

part: cell hover (20 distinct cells then reverse)
note: highlight by uniform word compare, opaque flat colour; walks only cells free of overlays

part: cell theme (palette replaced every frame)
note: eight shared palette words rewritten each tick, alpha preserved

part: cell scroll (11 px per frame then reverse)
note: see strip

part: cell resize 640x400 <-> 704x448 without remount
note: Scene has a fixed surface; each size change remounts the scene from the live state (the row is a remount cost)

part: cell glass over video
note: pane translates by a sine each tick, video each 4th tick; no group filter

part: GPU timestamps, hardware GPU
note: this adapter drives the CPU tile kernel on one core; the seam's Metal executor is not driven here
